name: Semo (Nigerian Cooked Semolina)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Gradually mix the semolina flour into the boiling water, stirring with a spatula until it forms a smooth and lump-free dough. Stop adding semolina flour when you can no longer stir easily.
Stir the semolina mixture vigorously to eliminate any lumps.
Once you have a smooth mixture, add a small amount of water to bring it to the desired consistency. Cover the pot, and cook for about 3 minutes.
Serve with your soup of choice.
